method.sourceAccess: Private original PDF. Rendered pages with PyMuPDF and inspected the actual raster pixels with view_image; all 162 physical pages were included in contact sheets.
method.rendering: Private 1.3x PyMuPDF page renders, grouped four pages per contact sheet; the source PDF and renders remain outside the repository.
method.visualCoverage: All physical pages visually screened for folio, layout, section boundaries, and visible structure. Contact-sheet screening is deliberately distinct from full-page text, entry, field, table-row, and semantic unit review.
method.pageMapping: Printed pages 1–82 map to PDF pages 2–83; printed page 83 maps to PDF page 92; printed pages 84–91 map to the same-numbered PDF pages; printed pages 92–160 map to PDF pages 93–161. PDF pages 1 and 162 are unnumbered covers. Printed p.83 is physically out of sequence after printed pp.84–91.
method.candidateHandling: OCR/text extraction and existing site names are candidates only. Neither was treated as proof of source-unit identity, completeness, or absence. The site catalog is not a source denominator.
method.changes: No catalog, citation, code, or source content repairs were made.
